purpose: Exact reproduction config for full-pipeline validation of the D-032 shortlist: paddle detector stride 3 + static target ROI (EXP-2026-08-28-roi-keyframe-grid).
sandbox: datasets/experiments/wave-a/H-runs/<case> (cp -R of datasets/paddle-bench/runs/<case>; canonical run dirs read-only throughout)
roiDerivation: roi_keyframe_grid.py:target_roi(case, span) — union of the largest-torso person's torso midpoints over the span from the case's people.json, padded by 2.6x mean torso span (x) / 3.12x (y), clamped to [0,1]. Span = report.detectSpan of the canonical run (the event-gated span, identical in the sandbox because pose/people artifacts are copied and events are pose-derived).

wm-volley-02.pipelineCmd: npx tsx src/analyzeVideo.ts <ABS video> --stroke volley --target-tap 0.5271,0.4552 --out <ABS sandbox> --reuse-extract

afn-sasebo-rally1.pipelineCmd: npx tsx src/analyzeVideo.ts <ABS video> --stroke volley --target-tap 0.5644,0.4665 --out <ABS sandbox> --reuse-extract

afn-sasebo-rally2.pipelineCmd: npx tsx src/analyzeVideo.ts <ABS video> --stroke volley --target-tap 0.7923,0.702 --out <ABS sandbox> --reuse-extract

windowChoice: Candidate detections were generated over the SAME window as each canonical paddle-dets.json (not just detectSpan±250ms) so (a) stride+ROI are the only deltas vs baseline, (b) the analyzeVideo reuse gate (window covers detectSpan±250ms with 100ms slack) is satisfied, and (c) S0 scoring covers identical label spans in both arms. Baseline wall-clock re-runs used the same windows.
roiSpanNote: The D-032 grid derived the ROI over the event-gated span; this run reproduces that (roiSpanMs = report.detectSpan). ROIs computed over the wider detector window differ negligibly (e.g. rally1 x0 0.0389 vs 0.0257) except wm-volley-02, where the full window's torso union degenerates to the full frame [0,0,1,1] — a production ROI must be derived from the event-gated span or it silently becomes a no-op.

integrationVerification.mechanism: analyzeVideo.ts runPaddleStage reuses an existing paddle-dets.json when --reuse-extract is set AND existing.window.startMs <= detectSpan.startMs-250+100 AND existing.window.endMs >= detectSpan.endMs+250-100; it does NOT inspect stride/roi. All three sandbox runs logged 'reusing existing extraction artifacts', zero 'detecting paddle candidates' lines, and the paddle-dets.json sha256 hashes were byte-identical before/after the pipeline runs.
integrationVerification.ballCandidatesReused: yes — canonical ball-candidates.json windows cover strokeWindow±1200ms for all three cases, so the ball detector was not re-run either

schemaCompatibility: detect_paddle.py now emits detector.stride and detector.roiNorm (additive; schemaVersion still 1; top-level keys identical to canonical files). paddleTracker.ts RawPaddleDetectionFile ignores unknown detector keys. Boxes are mapped back to full-frame pixels by detect_paddle.py, so downstream normalization is unchanged.

scoringConventions.waterfall: paddleWaterfall.ts convention: hit radius 0.08 normalized, label match tolerance ±40ms (S0 from paddle-dets.json, S5 from debug.json final track). Note ±40ms structurally punishes stride 3 at S0 (inter-frame gap 100-120ms).
scoringConventions.grid: D-032 convention: radius 0.05, stride-aware reach (label with no detector frame within half a stride interval = miss).
scoringConventions.cascade: cascadeWaterfall.ts criteria replicated verbatim in tools/paddle-lab/h_fullpipe_compare.py (TARGET/EVENT/PADDLE/BALL/CONTACT≤66ms/PHASE/STROKE-L1).

environment: MacBook (mps device). Canonical recorded detector timings (~70-72 ms/frame) predate this session; today's machine state runs ~113-157 ms/frame, so the timing comparison uses same-day back-to-back re-runs of the baseline, not the recorded numbers (both are reported in H-timing.json).
